title: X-Men
synopsis: A drifter with a metal skeleton and a runaway who drains life on touch fall in with Xavier's school, just as Magneto starts a machine to mutate the world's leaders.

title: X2
synopsis: A military raid on the mansion forces the X-Men and Magneto into an alliance against Colonel Stryker, the man who built Wolverine.

title: X-Men: The Last Stand
synopsis: A pharmaceutical 'cure' for mutation splits the species in two while Jean Grey returns as the Phoenix.

title: Iron Man
synopsis: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

title: The Incredible Hulk
synopsis: Bruce Banner, a scientist on the run from the U.S. Government, must find a cure for the monster he turns into whenever he loses his temper.

title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
synopsis: Logan's century of war with his half_brother ends on Stryker's operating table, where adamantium is bonded to his bones.

title: Iron Man 2
synopsis: With the world now aware of his identity as Iron Man, Tony Stark must contend with both his declining health and a vengeful madman with ties to his father's legacy.

title: Thor
synopsis: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans in Midgard (Earth), where he soon becomes one of their finest defenders.

title: X-Men: First Class
synopsis: Charles and Erik recruit the first class of mutants and steer the Cuban Missile Crisis, then split over what humanity deserves.

title: Captain America: The First Avenger
synopsis: A frail Brooklyn kid becomes the first Avenger and goes down with a Hydra bomber in the Arctic.

title: Marvel One-Shot: The Consultant
synopsis: Agent Coulson informs Agent Sitwell that the World Security Council wishes Emil Blonsky to be released from prison to join the Avengers Initiative. As Nick Fury doesn't want to release Blonsky, the two agents decide to send a patsy to sabotage the meeting...

title: Marvel One-Shot: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
synopsis: Agent Coulson stops at a convenience store and deals with a coincidental robbery during his visit.

title: The Avengers
synopsis: Loki opens a portal over Manhattan and Fury's team of misfits becomes a team for the first time.

title: Marvel One-Shot: Item 47
synopsis: Benny and Claire, a down_on_their_luck couple, find a discarded Chitauri weapon referred to as 'Item 47'.

title: Iron Man 3
synopsis: Post-New York panic attacks and a stolen mansion leave Tony with nothing but a broken suit and his own head.

title: The Wolverine
synopsis: Summoned to Japan by a dying man he once saved, Logan is offered mortality — and loses his healing factor mid_war between yakuza and family.

title: Thor: The Dark World
synopsis: The Aether resurfaces, Frigga dies, and Loki fakes his own death to take Asgard's throne.

title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
synopsis: Hydra has been growing inside S.H.I.E.L.D. for seventy years, and its best weapon is Steve's oldest friend.

title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
synopsis: Logan's mind is sent back to 1973 to stop Mystique killing Trask, the assassination that hands the Sentinel programme its blank cheque.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
synopsis: Five criminals steal an Infinity Stone from Ronan and, to everyone's surprise, decide to save Xandar.

title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
synopsis: Tony's peacekeeping program decides peace means no people, and Sokovia pays for it.

title: Ant-Man
synopsis: An ex_con burglar inherits a shrinking suit and pulls off a heist to keep it out of Hydra's hands.

title: Deadpool
synopsis: A terminal mercenary is tortured into a healing factor and a ruined face, then hunts the man who did it while narrating to the audience.

title: Captain America: Civil War
synopsis: The Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, and Zemo finishes them with a thirty_year_old tape.

title: X-Men: Apocalypse
synopsis: The first mutant wakes after five millennia, takes four horsemen and decides the modern world should be swept away.

title: Team Thor
synopsis: Discover what Thor was up to during the events of Captain America: Civil War.

title: Doctor Strange
synopsis: A ruined surgeon finds Kamar-Taj, loses his hands' worth of arrogance, and bargains with Dormammu.

title: Team Thor: Part 2
synopsis: A continuation of the documentary spoof of what Thor and his roommate Darryl were up to during the events of "Captain America: Civil War". While Cap and Iron Man duke it out, Thor tries to pay Darryl his rent in Asgardian coins.

title: Logan
synopsis: A poisoned, ageing Logan drives a failing Xavier across a border_country America, escorting a silent girl grown from his own genes.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
synopsis: Quill meets his father, a living planet, and learns what a father actually is from Yondu instead.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
synopsis: Peter wants to be an Avenger; the Vulture wants to sell alien tech; the homecoming date's father is the Vulture.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
synopsis: Asgard is a people, not a place — proven by Thor burning the place down to stop his sister.

title: Black Panther
synopsis: T'Challa takes the throne and Killmonger forces Wakanda to answer for the centuries it stayed hidden.

title: Team Darryl
synopsis: Fresh off being unseated as the ruler of Sakaar, the Grandmaster makes his way to Earth to start a new life. It's been over a year since Thor left Australia and Darryl has been struggling to pay his rent. Now Darryl needs a new roommate to help make the monthly payments. Unfortunately for Darryl, the Grandmaster was the only one who answered Darryl's "Roommate Needed" ad and with no viable options, the Grandmaster moves in.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
synopsis: Thanos collects all six stones and half of everything dies, including most of the people trying to stop him.

title: Deadpool 2
synopsis: Wade assembles X-Force to keep a furious mutant boy away from Cable, a soldier from the future who came back to kill him.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
synopsis: Under house arrest, Scott helps the Pyms pull Janet out of the Quantum Realm — and gets stranded there.

title: Venom
synopsis: A disgraced reporter is bonded to a symbiote that wants to eat people and, failing that, tater tots.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Brooklyn teen Miles Morales is bitten, and Fisk's collider drops five other Spider-People on him.

title: Captain Marvel
synopsis: Vers learns she was Air Force pilot Carol Danvers and ends the Kree-Skrull war she was fighting on the wrong side of.

title: Avengers: Endgame
synopsis: Five years on, a time heist undoes the Snap and costs the Avengers their two founders.

title: Dark Phoenix
synopsis: A rescue in orbit fills Jean with a cosmic force that unpicks Xavier's conditioning, and the team fractures over whether to save her or stop her.

title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
synopsis: On a school trip through Europe, Peter hands Stark's glasses to a man who has been lying the whole time.

title: Peter's To_Do List
synopsis: On the eve of his departure to Europe, Peter Parker tells Ned Leeds that he has several things to do before they leave.

title: The New Mutants
synopsis: Five teenage mutants are held in a secure hospital that turns out to be feeding on their worst memories.

title: WandaVision
synopsis: Grief_stricken Wanda rewrites a New Jersey town into a sitcom, and Agatha wants to know how.

title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
synopsis: Sam gives up the shield, the government hands it to someone worse, and he has to take it back on purpose.

title: Loki — Season 1
synopsis: A variant Loki is arrested by the TVA and finds the man behind the Sacred Timeline.

title: Black Widow
synopsis: On the run after Civil War, Natasha reunites with her fake family to burn down the Red Room.

title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
synopsis: A San Francisco valet is really the son of the Mandarin, and the Ten Rings want him home.

title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
synopsis: Serial killer Cletus Kasady gets a symbiote of his own, and Eddie has to make up with his.

title: Eternals
synopsis: Ten immortals who sat out every Marvel event explain why, then stop a planet from hatching.

title: Hawkeye
synopsis: Clint just wants to be home for Christmas; Kate Bishop and the Tracksuit Mafia disagree.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
synopsis: A botched forgetting spell pulls in villains from other universes, and ends with nobody remembering Peter Parker.

title: Moon Knight
synopsis: A London gift_shop clerk keeps losing days to a mercenary who shares his body and works for a moon god.

title: Morbius
synopsis: A biochemist cures his blood disease with bat DNA and gets vampirism as the side effect.

title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
synopsis: America Chavez can punch holes between universes, and Wanda wants that power to reach her sons.

title: Ms. Marvel
synopsis: A Jersey City fangirl finds a family bangle that makes hard light, and a Partition_era secret behind it.

title: Thor: Love and Thunder
synopsis: Gorr is killing gods, Jane is dying, and Mjolnir has picked someone new.

title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
synopsis: Jen gets her cousin's blood, his powers, and a superhuman law practice she never asked for.

title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
synopsis: Wakanda mourns T'Challa while Namor's Talokan declares war on the surface over vibranium.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
synopsis: The whole Lang-Pym family falls into the Quantum Realm, where Janet's old enemy is waiting.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
synopsis: Rocket is dying, so the team robs the man who made him. It is his story, not Quill's.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Miles meets a whole society of Spider-People who tell him his story has to end a certain way.

title: Secret Invasion
synopsis: The Skrulls Fury promised a home to have run out of patience and are wearing everyone's faces.

title: Loki — Season 2
synopsis: The TVA is coming apart and Loki learns to hold the whole multiverse together himself.

title: The Marvels
synopsis: Carol, Monica and Kamala keep swapping places mid_fight, which is a problem when a Kree wants revenge.

title: Echo
synopsis: Maya Lopez goes home to Oklahoma to get away from Fisk and finds her Choctaw ancestors instead.

title: Madame Web
synopsis: A New York paramedic starts seeing the future and has to keep three teenagers from dying in it.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
synopsis: The TVA prunes Wade's universe, so he drags the worst Wolverine he can find out of the Void to fix it.

title: Agatha All Along
synopsis: Freed from her Westview spell, Agatha walks the Witches' Road with a teenager who is not what he says.

title: Kraven the Hunter
synopsis: Sergei Kravinoff turns his father's hunting lessons on the criminals his father worked with.

title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man — Season 1
synopsis: A rebooted origin in which a teenage Peter learns the job under Norman Osborn's patronage.

title: Captain America: Brave New World
synopsis: President Ross wants Sam's Avengers; the adamantium on Celestial Island and Ross's own blood have other plans.

title: Daredevil: Born Again
synopsis: Matt hangs up the horns and Fisk runs for mayor. Neither retirement lasts.

title: Thunderbolts*
synopsis: Valentina's disposable killers are set up to kill each other, and the man they find in the vault is worse than all of them.

title: Ironheart
synopsis: Expelled from MIT, Riri funds her suit with a crew whose hooded leader deals in something older than tech.

title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
synopsis: Four astronauts and a world that loves them face a herald announcing that their planet has been marked.

title: Eyes of Wakanda
synopsis: Across three millennia, Wakanda's War Dogs hunt down vibranium that has slipped beyond the border.

title: Marvel Zombies
synopsis: The survivors of an undead outbreak cross a ruined America hunting a cure and the source of the plague.

title: Wonder Man
synopsis: A Hollywood hopeful with real powers auditions for a reboot of the movie that made Trevor Slattery famous.

title: Daredevil: Born Again — Season 2
synopsis: With Fisk's grip on City Hall now open war, Matt stops pretending the mask is behind him.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
synopsis: Erased from everyone who loved him, Peter works the city full_time as Spider-Man — until his own body starts changing.

title: Vision Quest
synopsis: White Vision goes looking for the memories and the life that were taken out of him.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
synopsis: Doctor Doom moves against a scattered Earth, and the survivors of several universes are pulled into one fight.

title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man — Season 2
synopsis: Peter's second year, with Osborn's patronage starting to look like a debt.

title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Stranded across the Spider-Verse and hunted by the Spider Society, Miles fights his way back to his own family.

title: Avengers: Secret Wars
synopsis: The closing chapter of the Multiverse Saga.

title: X-Men
synopsis: The X-Men, rebooted inside the Marvel Studios timeline.

title: Ghost Rider
synopsis: The Spirit of Vengeance joins the Marvel Studios timeline.

title: Black Panther III
synopsis: Ryan Coogler returns for a third trip to Wakanda.

title: Untitled Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings Sequel
synopsis: The sequel to the 2021 film set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) based on the Marvel comics. Plot TBA.

title: Marvel One-Shot: All Hail the King
synopsis: A documentary filmmaker interviews the now_famous Trevor Slattery from behind bars.

title: Nova
synopsis: A film set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) based on the Marvel Comics character. Plot TBA.
